title: Critique: non-neural learning and memory may not be the same capacities

statements.text: There is no conclusive evidence that what is called learning or memory in non-neuronal organisms resembles what cognitive science studies under those names.

sources.locator: section Introduction: two approaches for addressing the scope of cognition, reporting Loy et al. 2021
sources.quote: is remotely similar to what cognitive scientists are interested in when investigating learning and memory
